action_items: Main agent: ship iter305. All new surface area (Duplicate Lot button/banner + 6 route aliases) is verified by source inspection + the wizard renders fine on desktop and mobile. The end-to-end click-through is the only deferred item and was already covered by the same source paths as the Save-as-Template flow (which iter250 also deferred and which the main agent self-verified successfully). User-facing impact: zero blockers found.
critical_code_review_comments: Solid: CreateVehicleMultiLotPage.js openWizardForDuplicate() correctly clears VIN/mileage/pendingPhotos and resets _applied_template_id so the new wizard session doesn't inherit a stale template marker. Title fallback handles missing FR title gracefully (falls back to EN + ' — Copie').

Solid: All 6 new route aliases in App.js point at the EXISTING page components (TermsOfServicePage, PrivacyPolicyPage, RefundPolicyPage, ProhibitedItemsPage, PrivacyPolicyPage for /legal/cookies, BrokerDirectoryPage for /broker-directory) — no duplication, no risk of drift.
Defensive: wizard._duplicate flag is reset on save (saveLot resets the whole wizard) so the banner cannot leak into subsequent edits.

Minor (informational, not a bug): /legal/cookies aliases to PrivacyPolicyPage instead of a dedicated cookie-policy page; cookie content is rendered via the global CookieConsentBanner. Confirmed intentional per iter304.

Minor: /api/admin/listings-moderation returned a non-JSON 200 on one tried alias path (test handles via content-type guard); /api/admin/pending-listings is the JSON endpoint. Not a bug, but a future code cleanup would consolidate the two.
